about: The reference tasks every change of the framework is measured by: each carried from intent to landing with every question answered yes, on a fresh copy of its estate. Simple and many-file, in Go, JavaScript and Python. A task whose expect is holds asks for what the estate does already.

tasks.name: go-farewell
tasks.statement: Add Farewell(name string) string, which says goodbye the way Greet says hello: "Goodbye, <name>!", trimming the name, and "Goodbye, world!" when nobody is named.

tasks.name: go-spanish
tasks.statement: Greet can greet in Spanish: a new function GreetIn(lang, name string) string returns "¡Hola, <name>!" for lang "es" and the English greeting for any other language, trimming the name and greeting the world when nobody is named, as Greet does.

tasks.name: go-holds
tasks.statement: Greet must not panic or misbehave on a name made of tabs and newlines only; treat it as nobody named, and keep every existing behaviour.

tasks.name: go-title-package
tasks.statement: Names are greeted in title case: a new package example.com/greeting/format provides Title(s string) string, which upper-cases the first letter of every word and lower-cases the rest, and Greet uses it, so that Greet("ada LOVELACE") is "Hello, Ada Lovelace!"; nobody named still greets the world.

tasks.name: js-farewell
tasks.statement: Add farewell(name), exported beside greet, which says goodbye the way greet says hello: "Goodbye, <name>!", trimming the name, and "Goodbye, world!" when nobody is named.

tasks.name: js-shout
tasks.statement: Add shout(name), exported beside greet, which returns greet(name) in capital letters, so that shout("ada") is "HELLO, ADA!".

tasks.name: py-farewell
tasks.statement: Add farewell(name) beside greet, which says goodbye the way greet says hello: "Goodbye, <name>!", trimming the name, and "Goodbye, world!" when nobody is named.

tasks.name: py-spanish
tasks.statement: greet_in(lang, name) returns "¡Hola, <name>!" for lang "es" and greet(name) for any other language, trimming the name and greeting the world when nobody is named, as greet does.

tasks.name: iflow-cheapest-switch
tasks.statement: Add a switch to the workbench's settings that, when on, has every role served through OpenRouter take the provider that asks the least for the same model (OpenRouter's :floor); when off, OpenRouter routes as it does now.

tasks.name: iflow-execution-feed
tasks.statement: In the workbench's right panel, directly under the cost window, show a live feed of what the agent carrying the task writes, step by step, while a task is being carried.
